posts.title: DeepSeek 1017 Re-architected My App in 60 Hours
posts.description: I gave DeepSeek 1017 a real Electron app and 60 hours of active agent time. It produced 306 commits and months of estimated engineering work on a $10 subscription, and exposed four failure modes in how we supervise autonomous agents.

posts.title: Making a Log Viewer 12× Faster: A Go Optimization Guide
posts.description: A hands-on Go pprof tutorial: every command, every output, and every line of annotated source code from optimizing a real terminal log viewer.

posts.title: How to Install Boost in Any C++ Project: CMake, vcpkg, Conan, and Manual Linking
posts.description: A complete guide to installing Boost in any C++ project. Covers CMake find_package, FetchContent, vcpkg manifest mode, Conan, manual g++ linking, and building from source with b2.
